issues.message: Drawn for the decoration step, not built: minecraft:water, minecraft:lily_pad.
Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: cornflower, allium, cauldron, fern, sweet_berry_bush, oxeye_daisy, clay, brewing_stand, candle, white_wall_banner.
1499 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
12 layers tall: builders reach 9 without scaffolding, which isn't verified in game yet.

notes.artefacts: Carlton wanted the infirmary's red cross to read clearly; the hospital's 'red-cross banner' at (8,7,0) is a plain white_wall_banner (the file can't hold banner patterns), so it shows as a white rectangle and no cross is visible anywhere. His note is not met.
notes.purpose: Brewing stands, cauldrons and the bed rows read inside, but from outside nothing says hospital.
notes.levels: From outside L2 only adds props (shutters, dirt planters, a door canopy, lanterns, a white banner); the front views of L1 and L2 look nearly the same. Detail capped at 1.
notes.scale: The planters are bare coarse_dirt cubes standing in front of the wall at (3,0,0),(6,0,0),(10,0,0),(13,0,0): they read as dirt lumps, not flower boxes.

visual.summary: Adds the dispensary fittings (brewing stands, cauldrons, candles), chained lanterns, carpets, courtyard herbs, shutters, planters, a door canopy and a banner over the door.
problems: Healing sign does not read: white_wall_banner at (8,7,0) is plain white. Build the red cross in blocks on the upper storey over the door (as the infirmary v4 does with red_wool on white_wool), since banner patterns can't be stored and the banner shows plain white: e.g. red_wool at (8,5,1),(8,6,1),(8,7,1),(7,6,1),(9,6,1) with white_wool at (7,5,1),(9,5,1),(7,7,1),(9,7,1), replacing the posts at x7/x9 y5..7 and the pane at (8,6,1); keep it on every level, and move the banner at (8,7,0) so it doesn't cover the cross.
Planters are bare coarse_dirt cubes at (3,0,0),(6,0,0),(10,0,0),(13,0,0): rim them with spruce trapdoors or use a slab/trapdoor box against the wall.
L2 needs a clearly visible new feature from outside (e.g. the red cross plus a proper entrance porch or a herb lean-to), not only props.
Reach: 312 of 566 reached; unreached are roof, eaves, the canopy top (7..9,4,0) and a brewing stand top: fine.
